name: BoundaryGen

test_list.description: Corpus includes signed and unsigned boundary text values, zero and minus one.
Corpus includes NaN, positive and negative infinity, signed zero, and finite extremes.
Corpus includes empty, traversal, unicode, deeply nested and bounded long inputs.
Seed affects deterministic ordering without introducing randomness from the host.
No generated input exceeds caller-selected item and byte caps.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Maximum input count and per-input byte length.

output_description: Fixed boundary corpus with deterministic seed-based rotation and explicit limits.
